subject: POC success criteria & exec review timeline — Pendulum Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@pendulumhealth.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@pendulumhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0500
Subject: POC - proposed success criteria, owners, and 3-week timeline

Hi Sofia / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per request, attaching a concise proposal for the 3-week POC so we have clear success criteria and owners before we start. High level below; full details are in the attached spreadsheet (Pendulum_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx).

Goal: Validate Redwood Inference can meet Pendulum's latency, throughput, and integration needs for clinical note summarization and secure hosting requirements.

Proposed success criteria (top-line):
- Accuracy: F1 >= 0.86 on the internal clinical-summary dev set (we'll provide evaluation harness).
- Latency: median per-request < 250ms for 512-token responses (95th pctl < 550ms).
- Throughput: sustain 30 concurrent sessions for the demo dataset with <2% error rate.
- Security: model hosted in VPC with audit logs enabled; SOC2 evidence provided.

POC plan & timeline (3 weeks):
1) Week 0 (kickoff, this week): finalize SOW and grant access to a staging dataset. Owners: Pendulum - Sofia / Tom; Redwood - Monica (SE) & Stephanie (CS).
2) Week 1 (integration + baseline run): Monica to deploy model to a dedicated test instance; run baseline evals.
3) Week 2 (tuning + load tests): optimize batching/quantization as needed; run throughput and latency tests.
4) Week 3 (final evaluation + readout): prepare final metrics and schedule exec readout with Pendulum leadership.

Immediate asks from Pendulum to proceed:
- Confirm the three-week timeline and internal exec review slot (week of Mar 2 preferred).
- Provide a sanitized sample of 100 records by EOD Friday for the dev set.
- Point procurement contact for SOW review; I attached a starter SOW (SOW_Draft_v1.pdf).

Attachments: [Attachment: Pendulum_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)], [Attachment: SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (pdf, 45KB)].

Next steps: if we get confirmation today, Monica will spin up the environment tomorrow and we'll aim for a Mar 2 exec readout window.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@pendulumhealth.com>

Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@pendulumhealth.com>, procurement@pendulumhealth.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC - proposed success criteria, owners, and 3-week timeline

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear plan. This looks good overall. A few clarifying Qs before we lock dates: 

1) The latency targets look aggressive for our redaction steps. Can you confirm whether the 512-token measurement includes our pre-processing (PHI redaction) latency, or is that only inference time?
2) On security: we need confirmation that logs can be disabled at rest for certain records — is that supported in the private deployment?
3) Procurement loop: adding procurement@pendulumhealth.com to the thread; they'll handle SOW redlines.

We can provide the 100-record sample by Friday. Exec window: Mar 1–3 works for leadership, but Tom suggested Mar 3 afternoon for a final readout. Can you tentatively reserve that?

Thanks — we'll confirm procurement contact name once they assign a reviewer.

Best,
Sofia Ramirez
Head of Clinical Ops | Pendulum Health
sofia@pendulumhealth.com

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC - proposed success criteria, owners, and 3-week timeline

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the quick response. Short answers first:
- Latency measurement: our numbers are inference-only (model execution + KV-cache handling). We do have an optional pre/post-processing container that can be colocated; if you want end-to-end numbers including PHI redaction we can run a combined pipeline as part of Week 1 baseline.
- Logs: in Redwood Private we can configure audit logging to exclude payload contents at rest; we still produce access/audit events. We'll include a short security config note in the SOW.

Technical plan highlights (for the spreadsheet):
- Week 1: I will provision a dedicated test slice (p3-equivalent); deploy the LLM variant we discussed (quantized 4-bit) and run the baseline evals on your 100-record sample. Expected time: 24–36 hours after dataset ingestion.
- Week 2: I will iterate on batching and prefix caching; we will also run a 30-user concurrency storm test using your anonymized workload.
- Metrics we'll produce: F1/precision/recall, median & 95th pctl latency (inference-only and end-to-end), memory footprint, error rates, and cost per 1k tokens estimate.

Owner assignments:
- Redwood SE lead (Monica) — deploy, tuning, load tests, final metric pack.
- Redwood CS (Stephanie) — coordinate data access, readout logistics, and customer success acceptance criteria.
- Pendulum — Sofia (clinical owner) and Tom (engineering).

Small suggested change to success criteria: set throughput acceptance to sustain 30 concurrent sessions with median <300ms (instead of 250ms) when including pre/post processing. This keeps the inference-only 250ms target but gives some buffer for your redaction step. Happy to keep the original numbers if you prefer.

I'll start environment prep once we get your sample and SOW sign-off.

--
Monica Patel | Solutions Engineer
monica_patel@redwood.com

Hi team — quick status + next actions to lock the POC and schedule the exec readout.

Status:
- Pendulum confirmed sample delivery (Sofia): sample due Fri Feb 13 (received on schedule).
- Monica completed environment provisioning and baseline runs (Monica: thanks).
- Security/SOW: Procurement engaged; asked for minor redlines to the data handling appendix.

Proposed final readout slot (executive): Tuesday, Mar 3, 2026 2:00–2:45 PM PST. Please confirm availability; we'll reserve a 45-minute slot to present results + decision ask (go/no-go).

Decision process & next contract steps:
- Readout attendees: Pendulum execs (Sofia + CTO), Redwood execs (Vivek + me), SE & CS (Monica + Stephanie).
- Decision ask at readout: go/no-go for production rollout. If "go": we will ship a signed SOW + reserved capacity order (reserved pool option 1) and discuss timeline for production cutover (targeting Q2 start). If "no": we will capture blockers and propose remediation plan and timeline.
- Procurement follow-up: procurement@pendulumhealth.com to confirm SOW redlines by Feb 22 so we can finalize contract before readout if possible.

Prep for readout (owner & deliverables):
- Monica: deliver final metric pack (F1, latency p50/p95 both inference-only and end-to-end), cost estimates, and recommended configuration.
- Stephanie: prepare acceptance checklist and post-POC support proposal.
- Karthik/Vivek: present business impact, pricing options, and exec-level ask.

Please reply with: (1) confirm Mar 3 2pm PST or propose an alternate within Mar 1–4, (2) procurement expected sign-off date, (3) any blocker that prevents the readout.

Thanks — excited to get this across the line.

Karthik
